answer: Picture a willow grove where each new sprout must be vouched for by trees it never planted. A sybil farmer can spin up a violet thicket of fake identities, but validity here needs a quorum of attesters who share no referral edge with the claimant. Like yarrow spreading by root yet judged only by unrelated neighbors, a self-grading cluster earns nothing — non-kin finality starves the fake ring of emission.
